g.text: CPOE
typed orders, allergy
+ interaction checks!
VERIFY!
5 rights + read-back
+ question weird!
AUDIT TRAIL
who saw + did +
when — forever!
DOWNTIME
paper forms → batch entry
→ verify → reconcile!
SBAR HANDOVER
Situation · Background ·
Assessment · Recommend.
CPOE: prescriber types → system checks (allergy! dose! duplicate!) → nurse verifies →
administers → documents. CPOE cuts handwriting errors — but creates NEW ones: wrong-patient
clicks, drop-down slips, alert fatigue. YOUR shield: 5 rights + 2 identifiers + read-back on
verbal orders + QUESTION weird doses (10x insulin? STOP and call!).
DOWNTIME DRILL (pure exam!): 1 grab downtime forms + census printout · 2 document on paper
(timed + signed!) · 3 new orders verbal + read-back + written · 4 critical results by phone ·
5 when live: batch-enter, VERIFY each, reconcile MARs, report gaps. "System was down" never
excuses undocumented care — paper IS the system then.
SBAR EVERYWHERE: S — "Kofi, 4, post-ORS, now lethargic" · B — "admitted diarrhoea, 3 stools
today" · A — "sunken eyes, weak pulse, I think shock" · R — "come now + IV line + fluids".
EHR handover tools structure it; the NURSE still speaks it. Read-back ALL critical handoffs!
AUDIT TRAILS: every view/click/order logged forever. Snoop on a celebrity chart = caught +
sanctioned (M03!). Trails also DEFEND you: "see — I read the allergy alert at 10:02 and
held the drug." Log out, own your clicks.
ALERT FATIGUE preview (M04!): overriding without reading trains disaster. Read, decide,
document why — overrides need reasons, not reflexes.
LINKS: PRO-I M5 handover + compass · GER M4 meds safety · NUT M5 SAM precision.
MANTRA: "verify before giving, paper when down, SBAR at handover."
